The cache currently keeps every response. How aggressive should eviction
be?

❯ 1. Evict by age, keep pinned entries (Recommended)
     entries.body -> dropped after 24h, entries.meta -> kept (cheap to hold
     and needed by the index).
  2. Evict pinned entries too
     Everything above plus pinned entries after 7 days.
  3. Evict by size (LRU, 512 MB cap)
     Age doesn't matter, only the total footprint.
  4. Leave the cache as specced
     Ship what's implemented and tested now. Memory is not a problem yet.
  5. Type something.
